page.layout: One printed page, full width. Top: title line. Below: a woodcut diagram with a vertical text on the left and right sides, a caption above and below the figure, and a line-diagram at the foot.

main_text.head: FIGURA CABALÆ.
main_text.l: Omnia ab uno & omnia ab unum, & è contra.
Quod est { superius / inferius } est sicut quod est { inferius / superius.

page.notes: The central part is a woodcut figure (a radiant figure with a sun, moon, stars and a globe) and is not transcribed as text. The top-right margin shows show-through from the facing page and is omitted. The foot diagram has braces: "Quod est" followed by a brace with "superius" above "inferius", then "est sicut quod est" and a brace with "inferius" above "superius".
